title: Challenge verdicts
description: Output of the challenger agent: one verdict per eligible finding. `challenge` also refuses a set that skips an eligible finding, names one that is not eligible, or whose corrected_line is the line already anchored on.

line_ok.description: True only when the anchored line is the one the claim is about.

corrected_line.description: The right line in the same file, only when line_ok is false. It must be an added line or deletion site of the diff, or the move is refused and the finding held.

decisive_evidence.description: The path:line references the verdict turns on.

decisive_quotes.description: The first cited line of each decisive_evidence entry as written in the file, in the same order. `challenge --cwd` checks each reference against it.

answered.description: True only on a confirmed finding that was raised as a question, when the decisive evidence settles its answer as a defect. `challenge` then states it at minor, with reason as the answer.

reason.description: Required non-empty on partly and refuted, and when answered is true. A worse impact than the claim states is noted here; it never raises the tier.
